## Summary

Describe the repository-level change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `node scripts/validate.mjs` passes.
- [ ] `node scripts/generate.mjs` leaves both README files unchanged.
- [ ] Generator changes are synchronized with the Cordis application repository.

Plugin submissions must use [cordis.run/submit](https://cordis.run/submit). Direct edits to the exported plugin data or generated README files are not accepted.
